(use "assoc")
(let al (assoc-put (assoc-put (nil) "a" 10) "b" 20)
  (list (assoc-get al "a" 0) (assoc-get al "b" 0) (assoc-get al "c" -1)
        (len (assoc-keys al)) (len (assoc-vals al)) (assoc-count al "a")))

(use "g2048")
(list (cells-of (get (sweep four-twos 3) b)) (get (sweep four-twos 3) s) (get (sweep four-twos 0) moved))

(use "models")
(map (lambda m (list (vertex-count m) (face-count m))) (list sphere tree house gem ship))

(use "platformer")
(let w (tick (tick new-game still) still)
  (list (get (get w p) x) (get (get w p) y) (get (get w p) z)))
(sort-by (lambda a (lambda b (lt a b))) (map (lambda n (mod (mul n 37) 101)) (range 0 60)))
